study.proposed_difference: Register two standalone source-frozen minimal modules differing ONLY in literal CONFIG row_intervention (total_magnitude versus none). Remove inherited training-wide dense diagnostic summaries and optimizer observers equally. At calls0/512/8192 check returned-loss scalar, intended table gradient, padding/outside-eligibility corrections, direction error and eligible counts; these are correctness gates, not a new localization study. No new architecture, semantic conflict mechanism, stable-aggregation repair, literature novelty or observer-effect causal claim.
predictions: M and N have identical parameter counts, creation order, common-state forward outputs and BCE values. Same-file source checks enforce all differences reside in CONFIG.

At sampled training calls expected table gradients G+delta agree with autograd within relative1e-6; scalar BCE difference and padding/outside-eligibility correction equal zero. Failed checks cause a retained execution failure.

A positive seed42 M-minus-N AUC with non-worse Logloss is preliminary compatibility evidence only. A negative/mixed result leaves M unsupported for promotion. All outcomes are retained; no source or coefficient tuning follows this pair.

Later registered seeds42/43/44 must compare exactly these frozen versions plus baseline-din. Only consistent paired effects with reported cost and all outcomes can support robustness; three seeds alone do not establish significance.
falsifiers: Unregistered forward, parameter, optimizer, source or seed differences invalidate matched attribution. Missing calls are exported as-1 and cannot pass a correctness gate.
Nonfinite loss/correction or gradient mismatch above1e-6, nonzero scalar BCE error, padding or ineligible-row correction invalidates execution; retain cost and receipt without automatic retry.

M failing to improve its contemporaneous N, or future mixed/negative paired signs or execution spread comparable to the gain, defeats a robust-benefit claim. A single positive run cannot establish robustness.
No authorized seeds43/44 or user-level prediction vectors means independent-seed robustness and user-cluster uncertainty remain unavailable; do not invent them.
alternative_explanations: Generic gradient conditioning rather than semantic conflict removal. Magnitude retains raw complete-row direction in ideal arithmetic, not Adam-update direction.

Floating-point role aggregation and scheduling remain unchanged; stripped observers change allocations and may change trajectories. Historical versus new-source comparisons do not isolate observer effects.
Initialization and adaptive validation/checkpoint selection; many same-seed trials do not estimate independent-seed variation.
Inherited field/backward modifications explain gains over baseline; only M versus N identifies the incremental intervention.
